# Code of conduct

This is a small hobby project, but the same basic expectations apply as anywhere else:

- Be respectful. Disagreement about code or design is fine; personal attacks, harassment, or
  discriminatory language aren't.
- Assume good faith, especially in issues and PR reviews.
- Keep discussion on-topic and constructive.

Reports of unacceptable behavior, or anything else you'd rather raise privately, can go to
**pascalroose@outlook.com**. As a solo-maintained project there's no formal enforcement process,
but reports will be read and acted on — up to and including removing comments or blocking a user
from the repository.
